formulaBlock.normalization: Packet canonicalInci used as normalized list (ID-2); positions are one-based on that list.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1 without a prominent buffer: SLES (2) is the defining anionic and Parfum (4) precedes the only amphoteric (Cocamidopropyl Betaine 5), so no buffer counts -> strong.
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: The betaine sits directly after the early Parfum; in practice it buffers the SLES.

conditioningLevel.rationale: No conditioning system: no cationic polymer, silicone, lipid, protein or humectant route -> low.

weightPotential.rationale: No deposition family (HPMC thickener and citrus oil excluded) and strong reset -> low.

focusPrimary.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2). Formula care-direction verdict recorded for reconciliation.

careDirection.note: No repair or moisture route at all.

focusSecondary.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2).

usageRole.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2). Default regular; triggers (U2-U5, D1, U3) need graded claims.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Provisional: claims, name and directions are hidden in the blind pass (3.1); final value set after reconciliation (3.2). SC1 positioning unknown. CSA formula half fails: no comfort or humectant route; high fragrance prominence (Parfum 4) and citrus oil are counter-signals.

scalpGateFormulaHalves: S-SENSITIVE / S-DRY fail. S-OILY clause passes (strong, low, low).

formulaFacts.role: amphoteric after E3 point: recorded, not a buffer (C4)
